messages:
maria: Quick sync I pulled together the quarter's postmortems and there are a few repeating failure modes: autoscaler oscillation, DB failover cleanup, and job-cron spikes. Can we use this thread to lock owners and timelines for remediations?
aj: I'll export the incident CSV and slice by service + root_cause. Give me ~24h, I'll post a short matrix link.
sylvie: From the PMs/eng side: we had 4 P2s from cron batches overlapping at 02:00 UTC causing memory pressure and evictions. Many of those are single-region jobs.
devops-jen: Infra note: autoscaler defaults coupled with low min-replicas produced scale-down thrash. We also lack a cooldown metric tied to request-latency vs pod-count.
kevin: DB note: 3 failovers didn't do post-failover cleanup (read-only flag persisted) so pooled clients retried and hit max connections.
maria: OK. Let's convert those into concrete action items here and assign.

sylvie: Suggested items: 1) Autoscaler safe defaults + cooldown window; 2) Stagger cron windows and shard heavy batches; 3) DB failover runbook + automated cleanup job.
aj: Uploaded CSV snapshot: https://redwood.s3/quarterly_incidents_q4.csv. Query I used: ```sql
SELECT incident_id, created_at, severity, service, root_cause FROM incidents WHERE created_at >= '2025-10-01' AND severity IN ('P1','P2');
```

maria: Thanks AJ. Devops-jen, can you own item #1? We need a PR changing defaults and a rollout plan (canary). Target date?
devops-jen: I'll take #1. Deliverable: PR + canary rollout + post-rollout telemetry. Target: 2025-11-10. I'll include a simple synthetic load test in staging.
kevin: I'll lead #3 (failover runbook and cleanup job). Plan: write runbook, implement DB migration/job to clear stale read-only flags, add automated test for failover cleanup. Target: 2025-11-17.
maria: Sylvie, can you own #2? Coordinate with product on any cron changes and notify owners. Target: 2025-11-07.
sylvie: Assigned. I'll draft a short RFC and a per-service stagger schedule.

oncall-bot: Reminder: weekly incident retro Thu 15:00 UTC. Link: https://meet.redwood/retro

aj: Once owners open GH issues, I can run a quick attribution heuristic: for each incident, mark whether autoscaler tuning OR cron staggering OR DB cleanup would have prevented it. Helps prioritize.
devops-jen: Short-term mitigation: I'll implement a temporary enqueue rate-limiter that fires when node memory > 80% to reduce spike impact until sharding is in place. Low-risk change, I'll PR this week.
kevin: Also adding a Grafana panel for DB read-only flag prevalence so we can detect partial failovers earlier. I'll share the dashboard link in this thread.
maria: Tracking: owners open issues by EOD tomorrow, include rollout/rollback checklist and QA steps. We'll review progress at the Thu retro. Thanks all :thumbsup:
